newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on import needs.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on import needs.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker at 42.5450/42.5490 to the dollar in interbank trading compared with the previous 42.5390/42.5490, dealers said.
The taka remained generally steady after opening at 42.5450/42.5475. "There was little pressure on the market due to higher import activity," said one dealer.
Interbank call money rates closed higher at 4.75 percent to 5.25 percent against the previous 4.25 to 4.75 percent, they said.
